title: Amazon EventBridge to AWS Step Functions to Amazon S3
description: Create an AWS Step Functions workflow to export CloudWatch Logs to S3.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This template creates an AWS Step Functions workflow used to orchestrate the export of CloudWatch LogGroups with matching tags to S3 on a monthly schedule for archival purposes. The workflow is triggered using EventBridge rules. It also creates IAM execution roles with permissions to invoke Lambda functions, write to an S3 bucket, as well as the S3 bucket into which logs will be exported.
